name: IEEE Xplore Strategy
description: Strategy for IEEE conferences whose proceedings are hosted on IEEE Xplore. Inherits standard steps from _default and overrides the fetch step to use the IEEE-specific endpoint.

steps.name: Fetch Papers (IEEE Xplore)
steps.description: Call the searcher IEEE Xplore fetch endpoint. Uses the conference publication number from proceedings_url.

config.notes: Requires IEEE_XPLORE_API_KEY to be configured. The searcher extracts the publication number from proceedings_url.
